items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: We had Duterte for a while. We had Eddie Atkins and Duterte. King Oliver. Uh-huh. King Oliver. Uh-huh. Piku. Uh-huh. Had a guy called Chris. ... We had a good band.

ctx.x: Why did your brother play? Violin. What's his first name? Willie. Willie. Willie Foster. Yeah. I had Eddie Atkins. First we had Eddie Atkins.

We had Duterte for a while. We had Eddie Atkins and Duterte. King Oliver. Uh-huh. King Oliver. Uh-huh. Piku. Uh-huh. Had a guy called Chris. I never know what Chris's last name. Blaine Drum. Myself. Louis Kepp played guitar. We had a good band. Did you have some kind of a uniform? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. And a guy with a uniform?
